phase_name: Make deploy-headless.sh's three outcomes distinguishable by a caller

objectives.description: Runtime-confirm the consumer-staleness guard cannot influence exit code before writing any fix
Emit CONSUMERS_STALE=<n> marker and RESULT= outcome markers at each exit path; tighten header exit-code block

notes: Runtime confirmation performed against a real scratch git-init target using this repo's OWN real (populated) consumer registry -- bash -x trace showed verify_rc set before the consumer-freshness block and never reassigned by it, and a subsequent direct scratch-deploy run (invoking the SOURCE-STORE deploy-headless.sh, not the not-yet-redeployed .claude/ copy) confirmed CONSUMERS_STALE=44 and RESULT=landed_verify_red co-occurring with exit 3, and RESULT=not_landed with exit 1 on a usage error. Guard confirmed to hold; no code fix needed for the confound itself, matching the Scope Hypothesis's predicted branch.
